name: Power-Assisted Bicycle
description: A pedal bicycle of conventional fork-and-frame design, on two or three wheels, with electric motors of 500 W or less that stop assisting at 32 km/h; a throttle is allowed if braking cuts the motor. It is treated as a bicycle rather than a moped or motor vehicle; an e-bike past these limits that can't exceed 50 km/h is a moped.

restrictions.rule: Conventional exposed fork-and-frame bicycle design, steering handlebars, two or three wheels at least 406.4 mm in diameter, and an unladen weight of 120 kg or less
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, ss. 1, 6 and 7

restrictions.rule: Pedals operable at all times, and electric motors totalling 500 W continuous or less that stop assisting at 32 km/h; no combustion engine or combustion-powered generator
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, ss. 1, 8 and 9

restrictions.rule: The motor cuts out when the rider stops pedalling, releases the throttle or brakes, and it needs an on/off switch separate from the throttle or a mechanism that keeps the motor off below 3 km/h
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 8

restrictions.rule: Carries the manufacturer's permanent label stating, in English and French, that it is a power-assisted bicycle
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 16 or older, and the rider and any passenger must wear a properly fitted and fastened bicycle helmet
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 13

restrictions.rule: Needs a head lamp and tail lamp, reflectors, a bell or horn, and brakes on every wheel or axle that stop it from 30 km/h within 9 m
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 11

restrictions.rule: Ridden in the bicycle lane where there is one, otherwise on the shoulder or at the right edge of the roadway; never on a sidewalk or walkway, or a highway closed to pedestrians or bicycles
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, ss. 3, 4 and 5

restrictions.rule: On the Confederation Trail and other designated trails only from April 1 to November 30
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 5

restrictions.rule: No passenger unless it is built to carry one; a child passenger must be 6 or under, belted into an approved child seat behind the rider
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 13

restrictions.rule: May tow a passenger or cargo bicycle trailer, including an electric cargo trailer that keeps the combined motor output at 500 W or less
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 13

restrictions.rule: Must not be modified to exceed its power or speed limits, or to run on anything but its electric motor
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 14

restrictions.rule: Can't be ridden by someone whose driver's licence is suspended or who is prohibited from driving
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 13

restrictions.rule: Not a motor vehicle: no driver's licence, registration or insurance, though municipal bylaws on motorized vehicles apply unless they say otherwise
restrictions.citation: Power-Assisted Bicycles Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC557/21, s. 1
